findings.title: Broken access control: browser can rewrite the roles/id these routes trust (pre-existing, not in this diff)
findings.detail: `if (trigger === 'update' && session) return { ...token, ...session }` lets a doctor call useSession().update({ roles: ['receptionist'] }) or update({ id }) and defeat schedule/route.ts:45-54 and reassign/route.ts:46-48. Fix forward in the unit owning auth.ts: allowlist harmless profile fields only.

findings.title: Parameter pollution: all query keys are forwarded
findings.detail: Object.fromEntries(searchParams) forwards every key; only the exact doctorId key is overwritten. Build params from an allowlist (from/to) and set doctorId from the session for doctors.
